title: Namaz at Seeing a non Muslims
categoryChain: Namaz at Seeing a non Muslims
introduction:
NAMAZ AT SEEING A NON-MUSLIMS

Twenty-eighth: The Holy Prophet (s) is reported to have said: Whoever, upon seeing a Jew, a Christian, or a Magus says this prayer, Almighty Allah will not include him with the nonbelievers in Hellfire:

verses.translation: Who has preferred me against You through making Islam to be my religion,
the Qur'an to be my Book,
the believers to be my brothers,
and the Ka'bah to be my kiblah.
